message.content:
This editorial illustration features the title "TEMPO" in large red letters at the top, dated "31 MARET-6 APRIL 2014". Above the title, text reads "'PERANG BINTANG' TIMAH ILEGAL" and "BOEDIONO: SAYA MENGHADAPI MESIN POLITIK BESAR". Centered below is "CIAAAAT... KAMPANYE HITAM" followed by "Saling serang. Saling sikut. Isu Teddy Bear cuma salah satu."

The main visual is an old-fashioned television set with a dark frame. A large brown teddy bear wearing a yellow headband, a green jacket, a white shirt, and a red tie emerges from the screen. It holds a red megaphone in its right paw and its left paw is a raised fist. A pink brassiere lies draped over the bottom-right corner of the TV.

Surrounding the bear within or behind the screen are several animals: a small dark rat on the top left, a black-and-white cow head on the left, a laughing grey horse on the right, and a black bull head on the bottom right. The background is a textured, light-yellowish parchment color with a red border on the left side. A barcode and price "RP 35.000" are on the bottom-left edge.
